title: DSPy Teleprompters Module
summary: This module provides various teleprompters (optimizers) for DSPy programs, enabling automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and program refinement through techniques like evolutionary search, reinforcement learning, and Bayesian optimization. It helps improve the performance and robustness of LLM-based applications.

nodes.label: Optimize Program with Feedback
nodes.title: Avatar Optimizer
nodes.description: Iteratively refines program instructions based on positive and negative examples, using a comparator and feedback-based instruction generation to improve performance.

nodes.label: Analyze Performance Patterns
nodes.title: Performance Comparator Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that analyzes patterns in successful and unsuccessful program executions to generate feedback for instruction improvement.

nodes.label: Generate Improved Instructions
nodes.title: Feedback Instruction Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that creates new program instructions by incorporating feedback from performance analysis into previous instructions.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Optimizers
nodes.title: BetterTogether Meta-Optimizer
nodes.description: A meta-optimizer that combines prompt and weight optimization (fine-tuning) in configurable sequences, orchestrating multiple teleprompters for iterative program improvement.

nodes.label: Capture Execution Trace
nodes.title: Patched Forward for Tracing
nodes.description: A modified forward method for DSPy modules that captures detailed execution traces, including inputs, outputs, and parsing errors, essential for reflection-based optimizers.

nodes.label: Evolve Prompts (COPRO)
nodes.title: COPRO Prompt Optimizer
nodes.description: Evolves program prompts using a breadth-first search, generating and refining candidate instructions and prefixes based on evaluation scores.

nodes.label: Propose Initial Instructions
nodes.title: Basic Instruction Generation Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by COPRO to propose initial instructions and output field prefixes for an LM based on a basic task description.

nodes.label: Refine Instructions from History
nodes.title: Instruction Refinement Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by COPRO to propose improved instructions and output field prefixes based on a history of attempted instructions and their performance scores.

nodes.label: Evolve Prompts (GEPA)
nodes.title: GEPA Evolutionary Optimizer
nodes.description: An evolutionary optimizer that uses reflection to evolve text components of DSPy modules, capturing execution traces and proposing new instructions based on feedback.

nodes.label: Define GEPA Feedback Metric
nodes.title: GEPA Feedback Metric Protocol
nodes.description: A protocol defining the interface for metric functions used by GEPA, enabling the provision of scores and textual feedback for individual predictors or the entire program.

nodes.label: Propose Multimodal Instructions
nodes.title: Multimodal Instruction Proposer
nodes.description: A GEPA-compatible instruction proposer that handles multimodal inputs by generating updates for individual components based on reflective data.

nodes.label: Enhance Multimodal Instructions
nodes.title: Enhanced Multimodal Instruction Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for generating improved instructions for multimodal tasks, focusing on visual analysis, text integration, and domain-specific knowledge from feedback.

nodes.label: Fine-tune LMs (GRPO)
nodes.title: GRPO Reinforcement Learning Optimizer
nodes.description: A reinforcement learning-based optimizer that fine-tunes language models by collecting and evaluating program execution trajectories to update LM weights.

nodes.label: Infer Natural Language Rules
nodes.title: InferRules Optimizer
nodes.description: Induces natural language rules from examples and integrates them into a program's instructions to enhance performance, extending BootstrapFewShot.

nodes.label: Induce Custom Rules
nodes.title: Custom Rules Induction Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for inducing a specified number of concise and actionable natural language rules from provided examples for task guidance.

nodes.label: Select Few-Shot Demos (KNN)
nodes.title: KNN Few-Shot Optimizer
nodes.description: Dynamically selects and attaches relevant few-shot demonstrations from a training set to a student module at test time using a K-Nearest Neighbors retriever.

nodes.label: Optimize Prompts & Few-Shots (MIPROv2)
nodes.title: MIPROv2 Prompt & Few-Shot Optimizer
nodes.description: Uses Bayesian optimization (Optuna) to find optimal combinations of instructions and few-shot examples, bootstrapping demos and proposing instruction candidates.

nodes.label: Self-Refine Programs (SIMBA)
nodes.title: SIMBA Stochastic Optimizer
nodes.description: A stochastic introspective optimizer that uses an LLM to analyze its own performance, generate improvement rules, or add successful examples as demonstrations.

nodes.label: Generate & Append Rule
nodes.title: SIMBA Append Rule Strategy
nodes.description: A SIMBA strategy that generates and appends a new natural language rule to a predictor's instructions by contrasting good and bad execution trajectories.

nodes.label: Append Successful Demo
nodes.title: SIMBA Append Demo Strategy
nodes.description: A SIMBA strategy that adds a successful demonstration (example) to a predictor's demos list based on a good execution trajectory.

nodes.label: Generate Module-Specific Feedback
nodes.title: SIMBA Offer Feedback Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by SIMBA to generate specific advice for individual modules by contrasting better and worse program trajectories.

nodes.label: Optimize Few-Shot Selection (Optuna)
nodes.title: BootstrapFewShot with Optuna
nodes.description: Combines bootstrapping few-shot examples with Optuna for hyperparameter optimization, specifically for selecting the best set of few-shot demonstrations.

nodes.label: Retrieve Task Model History
nodes.title: Get Task Model History Utility
nodes.description: Utility function to retrieve the full execution history of the task model for a given candidate program and a single example.

nodes.label: Log Token Usage
nodes.title: Token Usage Logger Utility
nodes.description: Utility function to extract and log the total input and output token usage for specified language models within trial logs.

nodes.label: Calculate Proposed Quality
nodes.title: Proposed Quality Calculator Utility
nodes.description: Utility function to calculate the average and best quality of the last 'n' proposed programs, useful for tracking optimization progress.

nodes.label: DSPy Program Module
nodes.title: DSPy Module
nodes.description: The core building block of DSPy programs, representing a sequence of operations or a single predictor.

nodes.label: Training/Evaluation Example
nodes.title: DSPy Example
nodes.description: A data structure representing a single input-output pair used for training or evaluation.

nodes.label: Predictor Signature
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields for a DSPy predictor, guiding the language model's behavior.

nodes.label: Evaluate Program Performance
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluate
nodes.description: A utility for evaluating the performance of DSPy programs against a dataset using a specified metric.

nodes.label: Language Model (LM)
nodes.title: DSPy Language Model
nodes.description: The interface for interacting with large language models, used by predictors to generate responses.

nodes.label: Base Teleprompter
nodes.title: DSPy Teleprompter Base Class
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all DSPy optimizers, defining the common interface for program compilation.

nodes.label: Base Finetune Teleprompter
nodes.title: DSPy Finetune Teleprompter Base Class
nodes.description: An abstract base class for DSPy optimizers that involve fine-tuning language models.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Few-Shot
nodes.title: DSPy BootstrapFewShot
nodes.description: A teleprompter that bootstraps few-shot examples for predictors.

nodes.label: DSPy Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy Predict
nodes.description: A core DSPy primitive for making predictions using a language model and a signature.

nodes.label: DSPy Typed Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy TypedPredictor
nodes.description: A DSPy primitive for making predictions with type-hinted outputs.

nodes.label: Optuna Library
nodes.title: Optuna Hyperparameter Optimization
nodes.description: An open-source hyperparameter optimization framework, used by MIPROv2 and BootstrapFewShotWithOptuna.

nodes.label: GEPA Library
nodes.title: GEPA Evolutionary Optimization Library
nodes.description: An external library providing the core evolutionary optimization engine for the DSPy GEPA teleprompter.

nodes.label: DSPy Embedder
nodes.title: DSPy Embedder
nodes.description: A utility for generating vector embeddings from text, used for similarity search.

nodes.label: DSPy KNN Utility
nodes.title: DSPy KNN
nodes.description: A K-Nearest Neighbors utility for finding similar examples.

nodes.label: Rules Induction Program
nodes.title: DSPy Rules Induction Program
nodes.description: A program designed to induce natural language rules from examples.

nodes.label: Grounded Proposer
nodes.title: DSPy GroundedProposer
nodes.description: A component that proposes instructions based on program code, data, and other contextual information.

nodes.label: Create Few-Shot Demo Sets
nodes.title: DSPy CreateNFewShotDemoSets
nodes.description: A utility for generating multiple sets of few-shot demonstrations.

nodes.label: Adapter Parse Error
nodes.title: DSPy AdapterParseError
nodes.description: An error indicating a failure to parse the output of a language model according to the adapter's format.

nodes.label: Failed Prediction
nodes.title: DSPy FailedPrediction
nodes.description: Represents a prediction that failed, often due to formatting issues, and includes a reward for the failure.

nodes.label: DSPy Settings
nodes.title: DSPy Settings
nodes.description: Global configuration settings for DSPy, including default LMs, number of threads, and error handling.

nodes.label: DSPy Context Manager
nodes.title: DSPy Context
nodes.description: A context manager for managing DSPy's global state, such as the active language model or trace.

nodes.label: DSPy Parallel Executor
nodes.title: DSPy Parallel
nodes.description: A utility for executing DSPy programs or functions in parallel across multiple threads.

groups.label: Core Optimizers
groups.title: Core Optimization Algorithms
groups.description: The main teleprompter classes that orchestrate the optimization process for DSPy programs.

groups.label: Instruction & Prompt Refinement
groups.title: Instruction and Prompt Refinement Components
groups.description: Components focused on generating, refining, and managing instructions and prompts for language models within DSPy programs.

groups.label: Few-Shot & Demo Management
groups.title: Few-Shot and Demonstration Management
groups.description: Components related to selecting, bootstrapping, and managing few-shot examples and demonstrations for program optimization.

groups.label: Evaluation & Tracing
groups.title: Program Evaluation and Execution Tracing
groups.description: Utilities for evaluating program performance, capturing detailed execution traces, and logging relevant metrics.
